thread:
matt_h: hey @priya @samir need help — my year-end bonus got taxed as CA but I was physically working from WA that week. can this be fixed? 😬
priya_peopleops: sorry to hear that. can you paste the bonus paystub and your travel dates?
matt_h: attaching paystub (bonus_2028-12-15.pdf) — amount $8,500. i was onsite in seattle 2028-12-14 -> 2028-12-18. payroll still has my CA address. flight on 12/13, checked in 12/14.
samir_payroll: thanks. payroll will need proof of WA workdays for that pay period. if you were physically in WA for the pay period we can adjust state withholding and re-run taxes for that payrun, but W-2 may need a corrected reissue (W-2c). @emily_finance fyi on reissue process.
matt_h: what counts as proof? boarding pass, hotel, calendar entries?
samir_payroll: any two of: calendar invites with locations, boarding pass, hotel invoice, corp travel expense report, or a brief manager confirmation note. pdfs preferred.
matt_h: ok attaching boarding_pass_1213.png and hotel_invoice_1214-12118.pdf
priya_peopleops: added docs to case PAY-8472. samir, can you confirm next steps/timeline? if we reissue a W-2c, do we handle amended CA filings or does the employee?
samir_payroll: we can issue a W-2c if the adjustment changes state wages. if CA tax was already remitted we'll coordinate with the payroll vendor — typically the employee files the CA amended return if they've already filed personal taxes, but we'll assist with documentation. timeline ~2-4 weeks after complete docs.
emily_finance: also flagging nexus/tracking rules — short travel windows can still trigger employer withholding depending on payroll location. samir, can you pull the payrun id and do a retro calc?
samir_payroll: payrun id: PR-2028-12-18-RED-007. i'll run a retro tax calc and post the estimate here.
matt_h: thanks — i'm worried about double tax. appreciate it 🙏
payroll-bot: Case PAY-8472 created and assigned to samir_payroll. ETA: 3 business days for initial calc.
samir_payroll: initial calc shows CA state withheld $680 for that bonus. if corrected to WA refund would be ~$680 (WA state tax = 0). payroll vendor can issue an off-cycle refund if approved. i'll confirm after vendor review.
priya_peopleops: :thumbsup: we'll keep you posted. if you already filed CA for the year we'll give amended return guidance.
matt_h: lmk if you need a manager note from @jen_manager
jen_manager: confirmed — matt was onsite in seattle those dates for client kickoff. adding manager note to case.
samir_payroll: received manager note. will post a final update by 1865123600 (end of day).
